title: Peacock waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail fan feathers -->
  <g>
    <!-- outer feathers -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='38' ry='30' fill='#1a6b3c'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='34' ry='27' fill='#22854a'/>
    <!-- feather eyes -->
    <g>
      <ellipse cx='30' cy='38' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#0d4d2b'/>
      <ellipse cx='30' cy='38' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#00bfff'/>
      <ellipse cx='30' cy='38' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#ffd700'/>
      <ellipse cx='70' cy='38' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#0d4d2b'/>
      <ellipse cx='70' cy='38' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#00bfff'/>
      <ellipse cx='70' cy='38' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#ffd700'/>
      <ellipse cx='22' cy='52' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#0d4d2b'/>
      <ellipse cx='22' cy='52' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#00bfff'/>
      <ellipse cx='22' cy='52' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#ffd700'/>
      <ellipse cx='78' cy='52' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#0d4d2b'/>
      <ellipse cx='78' cy='52' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#00bfff'/>
      <ellipse cx='78' cy='52' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#ffd700'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#0d4d2b'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#00bfff'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#ffd700'/>
      <ellipse cx='38' cy='68' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#0d4d2b'/>
      <ellipse cx='38' cy='68' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#00bfff'/>
      <ellipse cx='38' cy='68' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ffd700'/>
      <ellipse cx='62' cy='68' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#0d4d2b'/>
      <ellipse cx='62' cy='68' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#00bfff'/>
      <ellipse cx='62' cy='68' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ffd700'/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#1e4d8c'/>

  <!-- left wing (waving) -->
  <g transform='rotate(-40 36 62)'>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='52' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#2a6db5'/>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='40' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#3a8dd5'/>
    <!-- wing feather details -->
    <ellipse cx='28' cy='58' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#5aadf0'/>
    <ellipse cx='32' cy='54' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#5aadf0'/>
  </g>

  <!-- right wing (resting) -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='74' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#2a6db5'/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='45' y='50' width='10' height='14' rx='4' fill='#1e4d8c'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='9' fill='#2a6db5'/>

  <!-- crest feathers -->
  <g>
    <line x1='46' y1='38' x2='44' y2='30' stroke='#00bfff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='29' r='2' fill='#ffd700'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='37' x2='50' y2='28' stroke='#00bfff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='2' fill='#ffd700'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='38' x2='56' y2='30' stroke='#00bfff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='29' r='2' fill='#ffd700'/>
  </g>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='53.5' cy='45' r='1.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>

  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='59,46 66,47 59,49' fill='#ff8c00'/>

  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='50' r='2' fill='#ff6b9d'/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <line x1='44' y1='87' x2='42' y2='93' stroke='#ff8c00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='87' x2='47' y2='93' stroke='#ff8c00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='87' x2='54' y2='93' stroke='#ff8c00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='87' x2='59' y2='93' stroke='#ff8c00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
